newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Healthcare in sale/merger talks.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Healthcare in sale/merger talks.

text.p: Integrated Healthcare Systems Inc said Wednesday it entered into negotiations with two companies that could lead to the business being sold or merged with a larger company.
The company said in a release that discussions with two unrelated information technology and service companies have centered on Integrated Healthcare's proprietary Data Qual information system.
The company said it hired an investment banking firm to help evaluate, negotiate and structure the proposals.
Integrated Healthcare said it had not entered into any binding agreement with either of the companies concerning a potential combination.
